world.title: 状态轨迹形成奇异吸引子
world.posterTitle: 公式迭代出的奇异吸引子
world.posterHook: 六套方程各自规定「下一刻往哪走」；光点跟着跑，久了留下双翼、螺旋与空心球壳。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 3D 投影 · 实时欧拉积分
world.question: 这些图形到底是怎么画出来的？
world.hook: 光点 = 状态，不是星星。公式没有随机数；切换底部名字换方程，拖动画布旋转，看不同肖像如何长出来。
world.payoff: 吸引子把轨迹吸在有限区域里却永不闭合。拉伸再折回织出永不重复的形状——规则确定，长期仍难精确预测。

en.title: State trajectories form strange attractors
en.posterTitle: Strange attractors generated by iterated equations
en.posterHook: Six equation families each say where the state goes next; points follow the rules and leave wings, spirals, and hollow shells.
en.question: How are these shapes actually drawn?
en.hook: Each point is a state, not a star. No randomness in the rules—switch names at the bottom, drag to rotate, and watch different portraits grow.
en.payoff: An attractor traps paths in a bounded region yet never closes them. Stretch and fold weave never-repeating shapes—deterministic rules, still hard to forecast far ahead.
